acceptance_rule: Every semantic condition below must be machine-checkable. Unknown or absent evidence is a FAIL. No parity claim until all 14 completion checks PASS and global completion is declared.
turn_completion: For the extension: a turn is complete when the Arena page's visible Stop-generating control transitions from present to absent. There is no browser-level assistant-turn-ended event; the DOM transition is the only observable definition. Status/completion readouts are display-only and never gate a send.
send_eligibility: DISARMED by default. ARMED + a captured site origin + model-stop transition + a non-empty saved prompt <= 2000 chars + the Send button present and visible. No idle timer, cooldown, rate cap, completion gate, status prerequisite, or /api/state call may block a send.
single_fire: One captured-origin typed prompt per model-stop transition. wasBusy is consumed only on an actual send; no-op ARM storage writes are ignored; DISARM stops all sends.
no_cache: No persisted translation results, no sidecar/state files, no cross-run reuse, no prefix replay, no memoisation across processes. C.4/C.6 memoisation is pure in-run (mlc_tab[bf] = ci+1) and disappears at process exit.
paired_speed: For every workload x size x mode x flag cell: fresh cold processes, output SHA-256 verified on every run, SA assembled with positional argv[2], interleaved A/B order, bootstrap 95% interval on PAIRED latency and PAIRED throughput ratios. GREEN requires upper95(latency) <= 1.0 AND lower95(throughput) >= 1.0. Input AND expanded bytes reported for every cell. Absent, timed out, nondeterministic or refused cells FAIL.
oracle: 24 pass, 16 refuse-parity, 0 FAIL. Refusal parity counts as a match only when both sides refuse with the same rc and no artifact.
